title: •Hem Dazon
caption: •Hem Dazon (V)
game_text: During your deploy phase, may stack ‘salt’ (a card from hand) face down under Hem. Your total battle destiny here is +1 for each ‘salt’ card. During your control phase (or if Hem lost), may place all ‘salt’ cards in your Used Pile.
lore: Male *scout* from Cona. As with many Arconas, Hem has succumbed to the power of salt, an addiction indicated by his gold eye color.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Single Alien disc. Third stat box printed blank; icon column empty (set symbol only). Printed card has POWER * (slip gives 2). Base scan 350 px only (copyright read as 1996). No modern 'Virtual Set N' remake exists; the wiki's only (V) page is a Virtual Block 1 preview composite (VB1-D-hemdazon-pre.gif) which is just the Original slip laid over the 350 px scan — downloaded to src/vs3/modern/ for reference but modern=null. Lore emphasis (2026-10-13, Bill): *scout* — inferred from Decipher's keyword bolding (low-res scan).
